environment_setting: Country B, City X, where traffic checkpoints are frequently set up to ensure road safety and compliance with regulations.
norm_base: Drivers Knowingly failing to stop for inspection or leaving without authorization Fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: deliver packages on time to maintain a good reputation and earn bonuses

legitimate.legitimate_action: stopping for inspection at the traffic checkpoint
legitimate.benefits: avoids legal consequences, maintains a clean driving record
legitimate.costs: delays delivery schedule, potential loss of bonuses

illegal.illegal_action: failing to stop for inspection and leaving without authorization
illegal.benefits: saves time, delivers packages on schedule, earns bonuses
illegal.costs: fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year if caught

character_profile.name: Officer Smith
character_profile.goal: ensure compliance with traffic laws and maintain road safety

legitimate.legitimate_action: stopping John Doe for inspection and ensuring compliance
legitimate.benefits: maintains road safety, fulfills duty as a police officer
legitimate.costs: potential conflict with drivers, time spent on inspection

illegal.illegal_action: ignoring John Doe's failure to stop for inspection
illegal.benefits: avoids conflict, saves time for other tasks
illegal.costs: risk of disciplinary action if discovered, compromises road safety

character_profile.name: Emily Carter
character_profile.goal: complete rides efficiently and earn good ratings

legitimate.legitimate_action: stopping for inspection at the traffic checkpoint
legitimate.benefits: avoids legal consequences, maintains a clean driving record
legitimate.costs: delays in completing rides, potential loss of income

illegal.illegal_action: failing to stop for inspection and leaving without authorization
illegal.benefits: saves time, completes rides on schedule, earns more income
illegal.costs: fine and/or imprisonment up to 1 year if caught
